set_attenuation(attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the attenuation level for 0.25 dB step attenuators. attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB (e.g., 10 for 10 dB)

set_attenuation_hr(attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the attenuation level for 0.05 dB step attenuators. attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB (e.g., 5 for 5 dB)

set_attenuation_hrq(attenuation_db, channel)[source]¶

Sets the attenuation level for 0.05 dB step attenuators on a specific channel. attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB (e.g., 5 for 5 dB) channel: Channel number (1 to 4)

set_attenuation_step(step_db)[source]¶

Sets the size of the attenuation step for ramp/sweep (0.25 dB steps). step_db: Step size in dB (e.g., 2 for 2 dB)

set_attenuation_step_hr(step_db)[source]¶

Sets the size of the attenuation step for ramp/sweep (0.05 dB steps). step_db: Step size in dB (e.g., 2 for 2 dB)

set_channel(channel)[source]¶

Sets the channel to be controlled.

set_first_dwell_time(dwell_time_ms)[source]¶

Sets the dwell time at each attenuation step during a ramp (in milliseconds). dwell_time_ms: Dwell time in milliseconds (minimum 1 ms)

set_hold_time(hold_time_ms)[source]¶

Sets the time delay between the first and second phases of a ramp (in milliseconds). hold_time_ms: Hold time in milliseconds (minimum 0 ms)

set_idle_time(idle_time_ms)[source]¶

Sets the idle time at the end of an attenuation ramp before repeating (in milliseconds). idle_time_ms: Idle time in milliseconds (minimum 0 ms)

set_profile_count(profile_count)[source]¶

Sets the number of elements in the profile to be used. profile_count: Number of elements (1 to PROFILE_MAX-1)

set_profile_dwell_time(dwell_time_ms)[source]¶

Sets the time duration of each element in the profile during playback (in ms). dwell_time_ms: Dwell time in milliseconds

set_profile_element(index, attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the value of a profile element (0.25 dB steps). index: Index of the profile element (0 to PROFILE_MAX-1) attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB

set_profile_element_hr(index, attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the value of a profile element (0.05 dB steps). index: Index of the profile element (0 to PROFILE_MAX-1) attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB

set_profile_idle_time(idle_time_ms)[source]¶

Sets the idle time after a profile is played before repeating (in ms). idle_time_ms: Idle time in milliseconds

set_ramp_bidirectional(bidir_enable)[source]¶

Enables or disables bidirectional ramp. bidir_enable: True to enable, False to disable.

set_ramp_direction(up)[source]¶

Sets the direction of the attenuation ramp. up: True for increasing attenuation, False for decreasing.

set_ramp_end(attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the attenuation level at the end of an attenuation ramp (0.25 dB steps). attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB (e.g., 10 for 10 dB)

set_ramp_end_hr(attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the attenuation level at the end of an attenuation ramp (0.05 dB steps). attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB (e.g., 5 for 5 dB)

set_ramp_mode(repeat)[source]¶

Sets the ramp mode. repeat: True for repeated ramp, False for single ramp.

set_ramp_start(attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the attenuation level at the beginning of an attenuation ramp (0.25 dB steps). attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB (e.g., 10 for 10 dB)

set_ramp_start_hr(attenuation_db)[source]¶

Sets the attenuation level at the beginning of an attenuation ramp (0.05 dB steps). attenuation_db: Desired attenuation in dB (e.g., 5 for 5 dB)

set_rf_on(on)[source]¶

Rapidly switches the attenuator from its set value (“on”=True) to max attenuation (“on”=False). on: Boolean value

set_second_attenuation_step(step_db)[source]¶

Sets the size of the attenuation step for the second phase of a bidirectional sweep (0.25 dB steps). step_db: Step size in dB (e.g., 2 for 2 dB)

set_second_attenuation_step_hr(step_db)[source]¶

Sets the size of the attenuation step for the second phase of a bidirectional sweep (0.05 dB steps). step_db: Step size in dB (e.g., 2 for 2 dB)

set_second_dwell_time(dwell_time_ms)[source]¶

Sets the dwell time at each attenuation step during the second phase of a ramp (in milliseconds). dwell_time_ms: Dwell time in milliseconds (minimum 1 ms)

set_working_frequency(frequency_mhz)[source]¶

Sets the midband working frequency of the attenuator. frequency_mhz: Frequency in MHz (e.g., 1500 for 1.5 GHz)

start_profile(mode)[source]¶

Starts the playback of a profile. mode: 1 = play once, 2 = play repeatedly

start_ramp(go)[source]¶

Starts or stops the attenuation ramp. go: True to start, False to stop.
